candidates.tagline: A $3,500 smart fridge with no dark mode — it lights up your kitchen like hi-beams at 3am
candidates.story: Samsung's Bespoke AI Family Hub side-by-side fridge (reviewed Oct 19, 2026) has a 9-inch touchscreen that has no dark mode, flooding the kitchen at full brightness all night, while the AI that justifies the $3,500+ price tag can only identify 37 fresh foods — and the voice-to-open feature opens both doors at once.
candidates.why_funny: Samsung built a refrigerator smart enough to talk to you, but not smart enough to dim its screen at night or know what a carrot is.
candidates.alt: Samsung Bespoke AI side-by-side refrigerator with a glowing 9-inch Family Hub touchscreen displayed in a minimalist kitchen with marble countertops

candidates.tagline: Apple mocked Android foldables for black bars in apps. Then shipped the iPhone Duo — with black bars.
candidates.story: Apple's own iPhone Duo launch keynote used competitor foldables' 'black bars' as a selling point, then shipped the $1,999 iPhone Duo with the exact same problem at launch; pre-orders on October 16, 2026 sold out in under 30 minutes with new delivery dates pushed to January 2027.
candidates.why_funny: Apple spent the entire Duo keynote dunking on Samsung for showing apps in a small window surrounded by black, then shipped a phone that does the same thing — and it sold out before most people could even place an order.
candidates.alt: iPhone Duo open in someone's hands showing two apps side by side on the large inner foldable display — Messages on the left and Photos on the right
